name: opentrace
description: Official OpenTrace plugins for Claude Code. OpenTrace indexes your organization's repositories into code graphs and serves them over a hosted MCP server, so Claude can answer architecture, dependency, and code-structure questions across every indexed repository — not only the checkout in front of it.

plugins.name: opentrace
plugins.description: Query your organization's indexed code graphs — cross-repository symbol search, dependency and subgraph exploration, bounded source reads, and the pull requests and issues around the code — through the hosted OpenTrace MCP server.
